data.credibility: Management generally delivers on near-term product launches, guidance, and acquisitions, while occasionally letting pipeline details like GL0034 lapse without formal updates.

lines.line: UNLOXCYT U.S. launch remains on track for second half of FY 26 and is delivered.
ILUMYA psoriatic arthritis sBLA filing scheduled for second half of FY 26 and delivered.
Phase-2b study for GL0034 target within 12 to 18 months was dropped after four quarters.
Consolidated top line growth guided to high single-digit for FY27; actual is 11.2%.
FY27 R&D spend expected at 6% to 7% of sales remains on track.
Organon acquisition completion expected in Q4 FY27 remains on track.
Tax rate expected in similar range until Organon closing is pending.

bull: Revenue compounded at 11.8% a year over five years while net profit compounded at 38.3% annually.
Operating cash flow reached 120% of reported profit over 5 years, showing strong cash conversion.
The balance sheet is nearly debt-free with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.04 against ₹89,280 cr net worth.
bear: Management dropped the GL0034 Phase-2b study timeline after four quarters without explicit updates.
Valuation stands at a relatively high P/E multiple of 36.8 based on the latest TTM snapshot.
Concentration exists with India Formulation at 33% and Innovative Medicines at 22% of revenue mix.
